title: About Us — Elevate Access Solutions
text: Elevate Access Solutions provides practical, personalized accessibility and assistive technology solutions for individuals and organizations. We help people identify, learn, and use technology in ways that support confidence, independence, inclusion, and everyday access.

Our mission is to help people use accessible technology with greater confidence and independence. We focus on practical access, inclusive participation, and solutions that support real needs in daily life, education, and work.

Our services are individualized, goal based, and practical. Recommendations are informed by professional knowledge and lived experience, with attention to the person, task, workplace, educational setting, or daily environment where the technology will actually be used.

title: Meet the Founders — Elevate Access Solutions
text: Meet the Founders — Elevate Access Solutions
Elevate Access Solutions was founded from a belief that accessible technology should be practical, personal, and empowering.
Professional photograph placeholder for Juanita Herrera

I am the co-founder of Elevate Access Solutions and have 15 years of experience working in the blindness field, including the past 12 years specializing in assistive technology. Throughout my career, I have provided personalized training on a wide range of assistive technology, helping individuals who are blind or have low vision develop the skills and confidence to succeed at home, in school, and in the workplace.

For the past three years, I have been a RESNA-certified Assistive Technology Professional, reflecting my commitment to maintaining high standards of knowledge, service, and professional practice. I have worked with children, adults, seniors, and professionals from a variety of backgrounds, combining technical expertise with my own perspective as a person who is blind.
I am passionate about helping others build confidence, increase their independence, and develop the practical skills they need to achieve their personal, educational, and professional goals.
Professional photograph placeholder for Fernando Macias

I am the co-founder of Elevate Access Solutions and have seven years of experience working with people with disabilities, with a particular focus on blindness, low vision, and assistive technology. Throughout my career, I have provided individualized and group training to help people use accessible technology more effectively at home, in education, and in the workplace.

My experience includes working with screen readers, magnification tools, mobile accessibility features, braille technology, productivity software, and other solutions that support greater independence. I have also conducted assistive technology assessments, developed training programs, and presented on accessibility and emerging technology to clients, professionals, and community organizations.

As someone who is blind, I bring both professional knowledge and lived experience to my work. I understand that effective technology training is not simply about learning commands or features—it is about finding practical solutions that fit the individual, build confidence, and support meaningful personal and professional goals.
The founders combine professional knowledge, lived experience with blindness, individualized instruction, and an understanding of accessibility in daily life, education, and employment.

title: Services — Elevate Access Solutions
text: Our services are tailored to individual, educational, workplace, and organizational needs.
to learn more about service options and pricing.

Our comprehensive access technology assessments identify the tools, features, and training strategies that best support each individual’s goals. We evaluate current skills, technology needs, work or educational demands, and accessibility preferences to develop clear, practical recommendations. Each assessment is designed to help clients, families, educators, employers, and rehabilitation professionals make informed decisions about assistive technology, training, and long-term support.

Our assistive technology training helps individuals build the skills and confidence needed to use accessible technology effectively in everyday life, education, and employment. Training is personalized to each client’s goals and may include screen readers, magnification tools, smartphones, computers, braille displays, productivity software, and other accessibility solutions. Sessions are practical, hands-on, and paced to support lasting independence.

Our workplace accessibility consulting services help organizations create more effective, inclusive, and sustainable work environments. We evaluate employee workflows, digital tools, and common workplace tasks to identify practical adjustments that improve visual comfort, efficiency, and performance. Recommendations may include display and contrast settings, text-size modifications, glare reduction, alternative software features, and targeted employee training. Each solution is designed to integrate smoothly into existing systems while supporting productivity, retention, and employee well-being.
